tools.name: search_tools
tools.description: Keyword search over the published catalog, with the site's full-text filters (Turkish task phrases, country words such as "turkey", facets such as "free" or "open source"); every word is read as finished, never as a prefix: up to 12 tools in rank order, each once, with id, name, kind, tagline, prici

tools.name: list_tasks
tools.description: Every task in the catalog, grouped by area in catalog order: each task's name, slug, number of published tools and page URL.

tools.name: find_tools_for_task
tools.description: The published tools for one task, by name: id, name, kind, tagline, pricing and tool page URL. An unknown task returns an error naming the closest tasks.

tools.name: get_tool
tools.description: One tool's card by id: tagline, use cases, pricing, auth, links and a code snippet, with its tool page URL and its tasks.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_tools, list_tasks, get_tool · Public sink: search_tools.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_tools, list_tasks, get_tool · Public sink: search_tools

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
